models_note: DeepSeek V4 Pro wherever an ML decision or a code edit is made: the planner (fixed design), the orchestrator (model-driven design, its planner) and the fixer. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, with reasoning off, for lower-risk work the planner checks anyway: the reflector's lessons, the researcher's queries and idea cards, the architecture map, and quick sub-agent tasks. Replaying real harness calls on Crusoe (2026-10-17): with reasoning off, Super VL matched V4-Flash on speed (1.6-4 s) and quality, and was slightly cheaper on input; with reasoning on it took 14-43 s. Without reasoning it failed a crash fix that V4 Pro got right. Nemotron 3.5 Lightning was cheaper but wrote an unsupported playbook lesson, so it is not used.
thinking_note: Roles listed here reason before answering. DeepSeek V4 reasons only when asked (chat_template_kwargs.thinking) and gets a 16k-token budget; it made one planner call take 129 s instead of 3-8 s, so only the rarely-called fixer uses it. Nemotron reasons by default, so llm.py turns it off (chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false) for every role not listed here.
